name: logical_canonical
signature: All kt_Rect/kt_Vec2/kt_Cmd.bounds in logical pixels. Physical only at input÷scale and output×scale boundaries.
notes: Slint/egui/Xilem proven. Anti-pattern: microui int-only, Nuklear scissor-only.

name: type_separation
signature: kt_Rect/kt_Vec2 = always logical. kt_PhysicalSize = explicit physical. ScaleFactor param on every conversion.
notes: C equivalent of Slint's euclid::Scale<f32, LogicalPx, PhysicalPx>.

name: per_window_scale
signature: One scale factor per KaintanaSession. NOT per-app global. NOT per-monitor-within-window.
notes: Xilem RenderRootState.scale_factor, Slint Window.scale_factor(), egui ViewportInfo.

name: dpi_first_class_event
signature: DPI change = kt_set_native_scale() → session flag → invalidate caches → next frame re-layout.
notes: Slint ScaleFactorChanged, Xilem WindowEvent::Rescale. Anti-pattern: ImGui ScaleAllSizes() lossy.

name: font_rasterization_density
signature: RasterizationSize = LogicalFontSize × RasterizerDensity. Layout sees logical size only.
notes: ImGui ImFontConfig::RasterizerDensity. Anti-pattern: Nuklear fixed-pixel atlas.

name: input_divide_by_scale
signature: Physical mouse/touch coords ÷ scale_factor → logical before hit-testing.
notes: Xilem p.to_logical(), egui screen_size_in_points, ImGui Win32 AddMousePosEvent.

name: pixel_grid_snap
signature: round(value × pointScaleFactor) / pointScaleFactor at tessellation time, not layout.
notes: Yoga pointScaleFactor, egui round_to_pixels(). Text gets forceFloor to prevent clipping.

name: single_render_transform
signature: Backend applies scale_factor once to entire kt_DrawData. No per-command × scale.
notes: Xilem Affine::scale on entire scene, egui ScreenDescriptor::pixels_per_point.

name: dpi_from_day_one
signature: Every backend must implement DPI before shipping. No retrofit.
notes: ImGui FIXME-DPI scars, Nuklear D3D11/GDI broken, Clay TODO AdjustWindowRectExForDpi.

name: native_scale_x
notes: OS-reported horizontal DPI scale (e.g. 1.0, 1.5, 2.0). Set by backend via kt_set_native_scale().

name: native_scale_y
notes: OS-reported vertical DPI scale. Separate for non-square pixels (rare, but supported).

name: user_zoom
notes: User-controlled zoom factor. Default 1.0. Range 0.2–5.0. Set via kt_set_zoom().

name: scale_changed
notes: Set true by kt_set_native_scale() when DPI changes. Cleared after frame processes invalidation.

name: kt_scale_factor_x
notes: Effective scale = native_scale_x × user_zoom. The value backends use for rendering.

name: kt_scale_factor_y
notes: Vertical effective scale.

name: kt_native_scale_x
notes: OS DPI only — no user zoom. For font rasterization density.

name: kt_native_scale_y
notes: Vertical OS DPI only.

name: kt_set_native_scale
signature: void kt_set_native_scale(kt_Session* s, float sx, float sy)
notes: Called by backends at init and on DPI change. Sets scale_changed=true, bumps layout_generation, invalidates text measure cache.

name: kt_set_zoom
notes: Called by Kain code. Clamped to 0.2–5.0. Deferred to next frame (egui pattern — avoids jitter).

name: kt_round_to_pixel_x
notes: roundf(logical × scale) / scale. Snap to nearest physical pixel X.

name: kt_round_to_pixel_y
notes: Same for Y axis.

name: kt_round_to_pixel_center_x
notes: (floorf(logical × scale) + 0.5f) / scale. Center a 1px line on pixel grid.

name: kt_one_physical_pixel
notes: 1.0f / scale. Expresses 1 physical pixel in logical space. Xilem Divider pattern.

name: kt_round_ui
notes: roundf(x × 64.0f) / 64.0f. Numerical stability for layout math. egui's 1/32 equivalent — we use 1/64 for finer precision.

name: win32_enable_dpi
notes: LoadLibraryW("shcore.dll") → GetProcAddress("SetProcessDpiAwareness") → PROCESS_PER_MONITOR_DPI_AWARE. Called before window creation. NOTE: comment says V2 but code uses V1 — future: upgrade to SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2).

name: win32_update_dpi_scale
notes: g_dpi_scale_x = GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSX) / 96.0f. g_dpi_scale_y = GetDeviceCaps(hdc, LOGPIXELSY) / 96.0f. Falls back to 1.0 if no HWND/HDC. Called at init, WM_DPICHANGED. MUST also call kt_set_native_scale() after updating globals (task 1.15).

name: win32_wndproc_dpi
notes: RECT* suggested = (RECT*)lp → win32_update_dpi_scale() → SetWindowPos(suggested) → win32_dirty_full(). SetWindowPos triggers WM_SIZE which recreates framebuffer at new physical size. MUST add kt_set_native_scale() call here.

name: win32_input_dpi
notes: g_mouse_x = GET_X_LPARAM(lp) / g_dpi_scale_x. Converts physical→logical. CORRECT. Should use kt_scale_factor_x() once bridged.

name: win32_fb_dpi
notes: framebuffer at physical pixel size. Called at init (line 716) and WM_SIZE (line 457). CORRECT.

name: win32_present_full
notes: Full-dirty present. DPI-UNSAFE — no explicit scaling. Relies on GDI auto-mapping. POTENTIAL BUG on certain DPI configs. Should use StretchBlt like dirty-rect path.

name: win32_present_dirty
signature: StretchBlt(hdc, dx, dy, dw, dh, g_hdc_dib, rx, ry, rw, rh, SRCCOPY)
notes: dx/dy/dw/dh = r->left/g_dpi_scale_x etc. DPI-CORRECT. Source in physical pixels, dest in logical pixels.

name: win32_present_invalidate
notes: r.left = (LONG)(r.left / g_dpi_scale_x) etc. Converts framebuffer coords → window logical coords. CORRECT.

name: g_dpi_scale_x
notes: File-static. MUST be replaced by session.scale_factor reads once bridged (task 1.15).

name: g_dpi_scale_y
notes: File-static. Same fate as g_dpi_scale_x.

name: win32_get_dpi_scale_x
notes: Public accessor for tree.c input funnel. OBSOLETE once kt_scale_factor_x() exists.

name: win32_get_dpi_scale_y
notes: Same — obsolete post-bridge.

name: null_backend_dpi
notes: Headless testing. Will call kt_set_native_scale(s, 1.0, 1.0) at init (task 1.16).

name: terminal_backend_dpi
notes: Fixed 80×24 cell grid. No DPI concept. Will call kt_set_native_scale(s, 1.0, 1.0) (task 1.17).

name: vulkan_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR → surface size ÷ window logical size → kt_set_native_scale().

name: d3d12_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: IDXGISwapChain::GetBuffer → framebuffer size ÷ window logical size → kt_set_native_scale().

name: x11_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: XrmGetResource("Xft.dpi") / 96.0 or GDK_SCALE env var → kt_set_native_scale().

name: wayland_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: wp_fractional_scale_v1::preferred_scale → kt_set_native_scale().

name: macos_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: [NSScreen backingScaleFactor] → kt_set_native_scale(). Integer scales only (1.0, 2.0).

name: wasm_backend_dpi
notes: Needs: window.devicePixelRatio → kt_set_native_scale(). Canvas: width=logical×dpr, style.width=logical.

name: dpi_awareness_modes
notes: V2 = Windows 10 1703+. V1 = Windows 8.1+. System = Vista+. Currently using V1 — should upgrade to V2.

name: query_dpi_monitor
notes: Win 8.1+. Per-monitor. Preferred over system DPI.

name: query_dpi_window
notes: Win 10 1607+. Simplest per-window API.

name: query_dpi_fallback
notes: Pre-Win 8.1 fallback. Currently what win32_update_dpi_scale() uses. System DPI only.

name: dpi_change_event
signature: WM_DPICHANGED: lParam = suggested rect (physical), wParam = new DPI
notes: Must call SetWindowPos with suggested rect. Must recreate framebuffer. Currently implemented correctly.

name: dib_physical_size
notes: biHeight<0 = top-down DIB. biSizeImage = biWidth × |biHeight| × 4. Correct.

name: font_dpi
notes: Convert logical points to physical pixels for CreateFontW. Automatic when DC is DPI-aware.

name: scale_factor
notes: 1.0 or 2.0. Integer only. No 1.5x support.

name: convert_coords
notes: Logical↔physical conversion.

name: dpi_change
notes: Notification on scale change.

name: framebuffer
notes: Automatically 2× on Retina.

name: scale_detection
notes: No standard protocol. Fallback: GDK_SCALE env var (integer), QT_SCALE_FACTOR env var (fractional).

name: xdpyinfo_fallback
signature: xdpyinfo | grep dimensions → physical mm → DPI
notes: Unreliable — many drivers report wrong values. Last resort.

name: integer_scale
notes: Integer only: 1, 2, 3.

name: fractional_scale
notes: Fractional: 1.25, 1.5, 1.75. Preferred protocol.

name: buffer_scale
notes: Client tells compositor its buffer scale. Compositor handles final output scaling.

name: device_pixel_ratio
notes: 1.0 standard, 2.0 Retina, fractional on mobile. Can change dynamically.

name: canvas_sizing
notes: CSS pixels vs device pixels separation.

name: dpi_change
notes: Media query-based DPI change detection.

name: ios_scale
notes: 1.0, 2.0, 3.0. traitCollectionDidChange on change. Dynamic Type via preferredContentSizeCategory.

name: android_density
notes: 1.0 = 160dpi (mdpi). onConfigurationChanged on change. fontScale separate from density.

name: slint
signature: Gold standard: euclid::Scale<f32, LogicalPx, PhysicalPx>. Type-system enforced. Per-window reactive Property<f32>. ScaleFactorChanged event.
notes: Kaintana equivalent: naming convention + explicit ScaleFactor param.

name: egui
signature: Three-tier: pixels_per_point = zoom_factor × native_pixels_per_point. round_ui() (1/32) for layout stability, round_to_pixels(pp) for sharp rendering. Keyboard zoom Cmd+/−.
notes: Kaintana steals: two rounding modes, zoom factor, deferred zoom application.

name: xilem
signature: Single scale_factor: f64 per RenderRoot. Affine::scale on entire scene. 1.0/scale_factor for physical pixel expression.
notes: Kaintana steals: single render transform, one_physical_pixel pattern.

name: imgui
signature: DisplayFramebufferScale × DisplaySize = framebuffer. RasterizerDensity separates font bake from layout size. Per-monitor GetDpiForMonitor + MDT_EFFECTIVE_DPI.
notes: Kaintana steals: RasterizerDensity pattern, Win32 DPI detection chain.

name: clay
signature: Zero core DPI. Renderer-owned dpi_scale float. Clay_ResetMeasureTextCache() on change. 4 backends = 4 different approaches.
notes: Kaintana avoids: fragmentation. Steals: ResetMeasureTextCache pattern.

name: yoga
signature: pointScaleFactor for pixel-grid rounding. Compute in points, round to grid. Text forceFloor. Version-bump cache invalidation.
notes: Kaintana steals: two-phase compute-then-round, generation counter invalidation.

name: vello
signature: No DPI — pure renderer. Validates that backends should be DPI-agnostic. Consumer owns all scaling.
notes: Validates Kaintana's architecture: layout in core, DPI-agnostic backends.

name: nuklear
signature: CAUTIONARY: fb_scale for scissor-only. Layout/fonts/mouse NOT scaled. D3D11+GDI completely broken.
notes: Kaintana avoids: partial scaling, DPI-unaware backends.

name: microui
signature: COMPLETE ANTI-PATTERN: int-only mu_Rect. Fixed bitmap atlas. No DPI concept. Zero scaling.
notes: What Kaintana must NEVER become.

name: DEFAULT_SCALE
notes: 96 DPI = 100% scaling. All backends default to this until OS query completes.

name: ZOOM_MIN
notes: Minimum user zoom factor (egui: 0.2).

name: ZOOM_MAX
notes: Maximum user zoom factor (egui: 5.0).

name: ZOOM_STEP
notes: Keyboard zoom granularity (egui).

name: ROUND_UI_FACTOR
notes: 1/64 logical point for layout numerical stability. egui uses 1/32; we use 1/64 for finer precision on 4K+.

name: DPI_BASELINE
notes: Standard DPI reference. scale = monitor_dpi / 96.0.

name: WHEEL_DELTA
notes: Win32 mouse wheel normalization: raw_delta / WHEEL_DELTA.

name: scale_from_dpi
notes: Universal formula. 96 DPI = 100% baseline.

name: logical_from_physical
notes: Input conversion. Mouse, touch, scroll.

name: physical_from_logical
notes: Framebuffer sizing, render coordinate conversion.

name: fb_width
notes: DIB/swapchain/backbuffer physical width.

name: fb_height
notes: DIB/swapchain/backbuffer physical height.

name: round_to_pixel
notes: egui/Yoga pixel-grid snap.

name: round_to_pixel_center
notes: Center 1px line on pixel boundary.

name: one_physical_px
notes: Xilem Divider pattern. e.g. at 2x = 0.5 logical points.

name: font_raster_size
notes: ImGui pattern. Separate from layout size.

name: dib_sizeimage
notes: 32bpp DIB total memory.

name: point_to_pixel
notes: Win32 font point size → logical pixel height.
